Paused · click to play
Shop
Click to buy (or press 1-5). Food heals you.
HEALTH
Touch: left thumb moves · drag anywhere else to look, pinch to zoom · tap to punch or shoot there · USE at counters, mailboxes and ATMs · hold ROB at a till
WASD move · Space jump (and get up from a seat) · Shift dodge roll · ← → turn the camera · Right-drag look · Wheel zoom
E use: shop counters (buy food, outfits, hairstyles), the ATM, a mansion's mailbox (claim it) · hold G rob a till
Click punch (fists) or shoot (police and criminals carry guns) · 1 2 3 fists / guns · R reload · V swing · Tab everyone in town · M menu
Jobs: every shop has a coloured job pad inside. Step on it: that's your job, your uniform colours and your spawn. Payday every minute
Crime: hitting an innocent person, taking someone down or robbing a till gives you wanted stars. Police come after anyone with stars. Get taken down by the police while wanted and you respawn in the jail yard (walk out through the jail whenever you like). Lie low and the stars fade. Hitting back at someone who hit you first is self-defence
Cars: walk into a parked car to get in. W/S gas and brake (hold S to reverse) · A/D steer · Shift drift · H horn · F siren · Space jump out. Stealing a police car gets you a star; running people over counts as a crime
Homes: the mansions across the river are free: press E at a mailbox to claim one. Citizens respawn at home

Grug City RP

A GRUG DIGITAL GAME

A sandbox city: shops, a mall, the boardwalk and a cruise ship, mansions across the river. Pick who you want to be. You can switch any time by stepping on a job pad inside a shop.
